title: Quantum Computing for Network Security Classification: Near-Term Classification and Long-Term Memory Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2609.36479v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum computing has already been explored in several network-security applications. However, how quantum computing may contribute to network-security classification in both the near term and the longer term has not been systematically discussed. This paper studies this question through two complementary experiments. First, we evaluate near-term quantum-kernel support vector machines (SVMs) on practical network-security classification tasks and compare them with classical SVM baselines on KDD Cup 1999, CICIDS2017, and BoT-IoT. Across these runs, quantum kernels are competitive. They can match or improve classical baselines in some settings, while classical RBF kernels remain stronger in others. This suggests that near-term quantum-kernel methods should be evaluated as practical, dataset-dependent alternatives to classical kernels rather than as uniformly superior replacements. translated_abstract: 量子计算已经在多个网络安全应用中得到探索。然而，量子计算如何在近期和更长期的时间尺度上为网络安全分类做出贡献，尚未得到系统性讨论。本文通过两个互补的实验研究了这一问题。首先，我们在实际的网络安全分类任务上评估了近期可实现的量子核支持向量机（SVM），并在KDD Cup 1999、CICIDS2017和BoT-IoT数据集上与经典SVM基线进行了比较。在这些实验中，量子核表现出竞争力：在某些设置下能够匹敌甚至超越经典基线，而在另一些情况下经典RBF核仍然更强。这表明近期的量子核方法应被视为实用的、依赖于具体数据集的经典核替代方案，而非普遍优越的替代品。其次，我们使用量子预言机素描（QOS）来研究……
tldr: 本文通过两项互补实验证明，近期量子核SVM在网络安全分类中可作为依赖数据集的实用经典核替代方案，并利用量子预言机素描（QOS）探索量子计算在长期内存效率方面的潜在优势。
